title: TraceEvent
description: One link in the value chain: session -> commit/PR -> ticket/initiative -> deployment -> outcome. Each record is a single edge between two nodes, carrying HOW the link was established and how sure we are of it — a chain is only as strong as its weakest edge, and that weakness must be visible. Value dimensions live on the edge as separate fields and are never combined into a single score. This schema doubles as the external integration contract a customer org reviews before deployment, so it must stand alone as documentation.

trace_id.description: Identifier of the chain this edge belongs to; edges sharing a trace_id compose into one session-to-outcome path.

method.description: How the edge was established, strongest to weakest: explicit_id_reference (ticket key in commit/PR, PR merge commit), vendor_tracking (e.g. Cursor conversationId->commit), branch_name_match (feature/PROJ-123), timestamp_correlation (session activity overlapping commit authorship — weakest automated method), human_assertion (an engineer said so).

confidence_class.description: known = deterministic evidence (explicit IDs). inferred = strong heuristic. speculative = correlation only; consumers must be able to exclude speculative edges and see whether conclusions survive.

confidence.description: Optional numeric refinement within the class; never a substitute for it.

evidence.description: Content-free description of the matching evidence (e.g. 'PROJ-123 in PR title').

value_dimensions.description: Attached where the edge carries them (typically ticket/initiative and deployment/outcome edges). SEPARATE FIELDS BY DESIGN — no composite 'value score' exists anywhere in this system, and every dimension admits 'unknown'.

priority.description: From the ticket system, normalized. Synthetic until a real ticket-system integration exists.

criticality.description: Of the touched surface. Requires org context; unknown until enterprise data supplies it.

ai_contribution.description: Strength of AI-attribution evidence along this chain — the same enum and rules as production_signal.ai_attribution (never inferred from code content). This is attribution certainty, not a size estimate.

id.description: Kind-scoped identifier: session_id, commit sha, PR number as 'repo_ref#123', ticket key, etc. Opaque/hashed where the source is private.
